# Harness task routing

Follow the project's own `AGENTS.md` for its requirements and conventions.
Questions and read-only reviews need a direct answer, not issue-delivery ceremony.

For starting, resuming, implementing or closing an issue, read the
[canonical lifecycle](../.copilot/instructions/harness.instructions.md) before acting.
It owns delivery gates; load the relevant language instructions when editing.
For other work, use the [workflow routing guide](../.copilot/instructions/workflow-tiers.instructions.md).

Host-specific discovery and prompt invocation are documented in the
[Copilot guide](../docs/github-copilot.md).
